title: Thorn Princess
format: Display typeface, 52 uppercase and lowercase letters
summary: A display typeface that looks elegant from a distance and turns sharp up close.
coverAlt: Large letters of a display typeface with small thorn-like serifs

blocks.heading: The brief
blocks.body: Design the uppercase and lowercase of a display typeface with a clear personality.

blocks.heading: The idea
blocks.body: Some people are kinder and stronger than they look. I wanted letters that read as graceful at poster size and reveal small, sharp thorns where the serifs would be.

blocks.label: Sketches. Pencil drawings of the control letters, n, o, H, and O.

blocks.heading: Process
blocks.body: I drew the control letters by hand, then built the full set digitally. The thorns were the hard part. Too many and the type looked angry, too few and the idea disappeared. The final set has thorns only at the ends of strokes.

blocks.caption: The thorn, from too much to just enough.

blocks.heading: Reflection
blocks.body: Spacing took longer than drawing. Next time I would space the letters early, because it changed how every shape felt.
